axes.model_access: The model family is disclosed via the official product line: the official-site navigation lists Kimi K3 / K2.7 Code / K2.6 / K2.5 (direct-fetch verified 2026-10-21), with the homepage headline "K3 is live, built for agentic coding and knowledge work"; the open-platform API provides model interfaces on a separate line.
axes.runtime: Web is the main entry, plus desktop and mobile apps; generation is processed in the cloud and data is stored on servers within mainland China (official data usage & sharing notice).
axes.local_files: Long-document parsing and retrieval are the flagship capabilities; product-line entries incl. PPT/deep research/documents/spreadsheets/build-apps are supported (verified via direct fetch of the official-site navigation); uploaded content is stored in the account.
axes.background: The official-site navigation has a "scheduled tasks" entry (direct-fetch verified 2026-10-21); the Agent-task form has an official product line ("just ask, or make an Agent task"); offline-continuation details not verified item by item.
axes.tools: The official product line includes PPT, deep research, documents, spreadsheets, design, build-apps and a plugin ecosystem; there is also the open-platform API (Moonshot open platform).
axes.context: Has project spaces and history-session organization (syncs across devices when signed in); the cross-session memory mechanism is not verified item by item — the official site has entries like an "inspiration library", but this site has not verified official docs for a standalone memory-management interface.
axes.permissions: Official data usage & sharing notice: on the premise of "processing with secure encryption, strict de-identification such that specific individuals cannot be re-identified", inputs, prompts and generated replies may be used for model training; opting out requires registering with customer service (5-7 business days after identity verification), it is an account-level uniform opt-out with no per-chat opt-out, and after opting out neither historical nor new data enters the training set. Kimi Business promises enterprise data never enters the model training pipeline, with personal and enterprise spaces fully isolated.
axes.fit: The workhorse for Chinese long-document scenarios. Opting out of training goes through customer-service registration, not a self-service switch — confirm this first if it matters to you; enterprise data goes through Kimi Business. For running models locally, it is not suitable.

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The coding-oriented test protocol is at [protocols/coding/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/coding/_protocol.md) (the coding task suite does not apply to chat products).
